S.FORM: 75-7-27 a romiad misatapangay a paluwad tonya siwa finacadan a paniyaro'an, itini i fangcalay a pasadak tono yincumin akahilahila a serangawan, itini i makapahay a lotok ato pahanaan, saka adihay ko maolahay a lafan a tayni misalama, itini i taywan o sata angayay no paputal a po u kwan, saka adihay ko tiniay a minengneng tono yincumin a demak, naw hani o icuwacuwaay a kayko tayni a liwku, paka alaw cangra to tokopic no taywan a wenfa. Tonya siwa finacadan haw i, iraay ko tolo taangayay a kasapinangan Saka cecay siwa ko finacadan, o tayal, o amis, o paiwan, o bunun, O saysiyat, o piyuma, o rukay, o tsou, o yami, kahilahila ko demak ato pinangan, o pafana to tayniay a lafan, ato pafana to ka i kolay teluc, toya lihoc sataangayay o no yincumin a sacecay cecay a luma pikaysak, ira ko kakeruan ato kikian kadufa musiruy a nengnengen. mapatasekal mafana ko cimacima a tayniay a widang, o yincumin no taywan tadafancalay. Saka tusa o pisalamaan fasiw fafiw sanay, o kaolahan no wawa a misalama, ano awa ko icel no falocu akato pikalic, ira ko yufu sawi i cilang taykonsan mayatansyin haytawcan cinkwasan kahilahila atasalamaan, mahemek ko wawa a tayra. saka tolo o pahanaan kahilahila no hana tadamakapahay, iraay ko kisya to pikalican, taliyok han no kisya a cumikay, salipahak sako falucu a minengneng to makapahay a hana. 85-7-27 aromi ad ira ko pikiting a kayki, saka no yincumi a romiad, toya lalomaay a kahilahila dafung adihaya ko pipadang no yincumin saan, mikansya patikul to pipadama saan, toya romiad o pinokayan no yincumin, malacecay mahemek lipahak a misalama.
S.PHON: **-*-** a ro~umiaɬ~ɮ misatapaŋaj a paɾo~u~uwaɬ~ɮ to~unja siwa finaʦaɬ~ɮan a panijaro~uʡan, itini i faŋʦaɾaj a pasaɬ~ɮak to~uno~u jinʦo~u~umin akaħiɾaħiɾa a səraŋawan, itini i makapaħaj a ɾo~uto~uk ato~u paħanaan, saka aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u mao~uɾaħaj a ɾafan a tajni misaɾama, itini i tajwan o~u sata aŋajaj no~u papo~u~utaɾ a po~u o~u~u kwan, saka aɬ~ɮiħaj ko~u tiniaj a minəŋnəŋ to~uno~u jinʦo~u~umin a ɬ~ɮəmak, naw ħani o~u iʦo~u~uwaʦo~u~uwaaj a kajko~u tajni a ɾiwko~u~u, paka aɾaw ʦaŋra to~u to~uko~upiʦ no~u tajwan a wənfa. to~unja siwa finaʦaɬ~ɮan ħaw i, iraaj ko~u to~uɾo~u taaŋajaj a kasapinaŋan saka ʦəʦaj siwa ko~u finaʦaɬ~ɮan, o~u tajaɾ, o~u amis, o~u paiwan, o~u b~b~vo~u~uno~u~un, o~u sajsijat, o~u pijo~u~uma, o~u ro~u~ukaj, o~u tso~uo~u~u, o~u jami, kaħiɾaħiɾa ko~u ɬ~ɮəmak ato~u pinaŋan, o~u pafana to~u tajniaj a ɾafan, ato~u pafana to~u ka i ko~uɾaj təɾo~u~uʦ, to~uja ɾiħo~uʦ sataaŋajaj o~u no~u jinʦo~u~umin a saʦəʦaj ʦəʦaj a ɾo~u~uma pikajsak, ira ko~u kakəro~u~uan ato~u kikian kaɬ~ɮo~u~ufa mo~u~usiro~u~uj a nəŋnəŋən. mapatasəkaɾ mafana ko~u ʦimaʦima a tajniaj a wiɬ~ɮaŋ, o~u jinʦo~u~umin no~u tajwan taɬ~ɮafanʦaɾaj. saka to~u~usa o~u pisaɾamaan fasiw fafiw sanaj, o~u kao~uɾaħan no~u wawa a misaɾama, ano~u awa ko~u iʦəɾ no~u faɾo~uʦo~u~u akato~u pikaɾiʦ, ira ko~u jo~u~ufo~u~u sawi i ʦiɾaŋ tajko~unsan majatansjin ħajtawʦan ʦinkwasan kaħiɾaħiɾa atasaɾamaan, maħəmək ko~u wawa a tajra. saka to~uɾo~u o~u paħanaan kaħiɾaħiɾa no~u ħana taɬ~ɮamakapaħaj, iraaj ko~u kisja to~u pikaɾiʦan, taɾijo~uk ħan no~u kisja a ʦo~u~umikaj, saɾipaħak sako~u faɾo~u~uʦo~u~u a minəŋnəŋ to~u makapaħaj a ħana. **-*-** aro~umi aɬ~ɮ ira ko~u pikitiŋ a kajki, saka no~u jinʦo~u~umi a ro~umiaɬ~ɮ, to~uja ɾaɾo~umaaj a kaħiɾaħiɾa ɬ~ɮafo~u~uŋ aɬ~ɮiħaja ko~u pipaɬ~ɮaŋ no~u jinʦo~u~umin saan, mikansja patiko~u~uɾ to~u pipaɬ~ɮama saan, to~uja ro~umiaɬ~ɮ o~u pino~ukajan no~u jinʦo~u~umin, maɾaʦəʦaj maħəmək ɾipaħak a misaɾama.
